doc: The tracks on disk (res://assets/audio/music/<stem>.ogg) as Mano's phone and the credits name them: title and artist, as assets/audio/CREDITS.md credits them. The sit-downs, the playlist and the finale use only these six (docs/DESIGN.md §9). `playlist` is the three songs Toma's playlist pick offers in chapter 3 (c3.playlist_pick); `heard` is false for cues that are not songs anyone would put on a playlist (the phone's Music list leaves them out).
